summary: iter133 — Full end-to-end verification of Customer Expo app 6-step booking/checkout (1:1 port of Web Customer Panel). Backend: 12/12 pytest PASS (send-otp, verify-otp customer+new-user, partner-blocked at role level, catalog/upsell, ratecards search+by-service, cart-quote guest+auth, validate-coupon invalid, wallet, grouped booking with idempotency + mock payment, bookings list). Frontend (Expo web http://localhost:3001): full GUEST flow succeeds — /services renders, ratecard search returns results, quick-add works, view-booking-bar navigates to /book, all 6 steps (Services→Details→Schedule→Your Info→Summary→Confirm) render with correct testids, guest OTP inline for existing customer 9000000004 auto-fills 123456 and logs in inline (toast 'Welcome, Priya Verma'), Home 12 MG Road saved-addr chip renders, invalid coupon returns 'Invalid or inactive coupon', pay-wallet enabled (balance ₹1,000 ≥ total ₹665.71), place-order → order-success 'Order placed! 1 booking confirmed & paid · ₹665.71'. Multi-category order (Carpentry + Appliance Repair) creates 2 bookings with same order_group_id, category-charges-table visible at Summary, order-group-summary shows both invoices #AZOIJR3XU + #AZOGVLL2E and Combined total ₹1,524.78. Partner phone 9000000003 correctly BLOCKED at Step 4 with toast 'This account is not a customer account. Please use a customer mobile number.' and OTP form resets. New-user flow: unknown phone → otp-name + otp-signup → creates customer + logs in → contact-user renders. Empty /book → cart-empty + browse-services. Cart cleared after success.

critical_code_review_comments: book.tsx placeOrder loops per-category but sets apply_visiting/apply_emergency=true only for first group — behaviour matches web reference; consider unit-testing the group iteration for >2 categories to ensure visiting/emergency are never double-charged.
Coupon apply is gated behind login (toast says 'verify your mobile' when guest) — matches web parity but a subtle UX note: user might expect coupon to be applyable at Summary step. Not a bug.
